title: [Snyk] SNYK-PYTHON-TORCH-10337825 in torch@2.11.0
description:
## Mismatched Memory Management Routines

**Severity:** medium
**Package:** torch@2.11.0
**File:** `pyproject.toml`

**CVSS Score:** 4.8  
**Exploit Maturity:** proof-of-concept  
**Snyk Priority Score:** 347/1000

### CVEs
- [CVE-2025-3136](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-3136)

**Fix:** No automatic fix available. Review manually.

### Details
## Overview
[torch](https://pypi.org/project/torch) is a Tensors and Dynamic neural networks in Python with strong GPU acceleration

Affected versions of this package are vulnerable to Mismatched Memory Management Routines through the `torch.cuda.memory.caching_allocator_delete` function. An attacker can corrupt memory by manipulating the function locally.
## Remediation
There is no fixed version for `torch`.
